description.value: Park Central Hotel New York is a 25-story hotel located southwest of Carnegie Hall at 870 7th Avenue. Wikipedia places it between West 55th and 56th streets, which puts Central Park and the Theater District within walking distance. It is a large, practical Midtown base for a first trip to the city. Trip.com shows 8.0 / 10 Very good 185 reviews. Representative Trip.com praise (guest reviews): “The hotel's biggest advantage is its incredibly convenient location”. Representative watch-outs: “The room amenities are basic”; “My room faced the street, which was a bit noisy”.
